name: hermes-matchlock-adapter-contract
description: Real export and behavior scope of the standalone Matchlock Hermes adapter (src/installer/matchlock/), INCLUDING the MTLK-HERMES-GUARD config admission corrections (parse/read/check never turn a config problem into ok:true; the plan facade never yields a launch descriptor on refusal; diagnostics are bounded and never copy raw config content). Grounded in the compiled module dist/installer/matchlock/hermes-adapter.js — every value export listed here was verified present via runtime introspection, not asserted from source alone. Interface changes vs the previous delivery are coordinated in /root/matchlock-work/hermes-guard-contract.json (published at guard stage end); /root/matchlock-work/hermes-contract.json remains the untouched prior delivery contract.

rules: Explicit --profile flag always wins; resolved via the profile-env helper, missing/deleted/invalid -> native refusal.
No flag but HERMES_HOME set to a dir whose IMMEDIATE parent is 'profiles': trusted unconditionally (NO marker condition on the grandparent).
No flag and HERMES_HOME not a profiles/<name> dir (or unset): read the sticky active_profile FILE from the effective root; config.yaml active_profile is NOT consulted on this path (source-observed).
Missing/deleted/invalid/reserved selected profile -> refusal, mirroring native SystemExit(1).
Otherwise the default profile (the home root itself).
Reserved ids mirror native _RESERVED_NAMES {hermes, default, test, tmp, root, sudo}; 'default' is folded to the home root and never reaches the set.
profileResolution.selectionRefusal: When the native CLI would refuse the captured selection, plan.refused / plan.selectionRefused = true with a refusedReason; the controller must not launch.

externalDependencies.honestScope: no scenario currently requires an outside-scope dependency. Native skills/auth resolve from the effective HERMES_HOME (<home>/skills, <home>/.env), and the selected profile directory IS that home, so siblings/root markers are neighbors only. required is always false today; the adapter never emits required=true without concrete proof.

incompleteEvidence: NULL token columns -> status 'ambiguous' (never a verified zero).
non-finite / non-numeric summed fields -> computeHermesTokenTotal returns NaN -> status 'unavailable' (never clamped to zero).
missing session row / missing state.db / read error -> 'unavailable' / 'truncated'.
storeTokenAccounting.scope: storeDir is always passed explicitly; module never derives it from process.env or falls back to a host default.

configAdmissionGuard.purpose: MTLK-HERMES-GUARD descriptor-stage admission for the effective terminal backend. Source-grounded in hermes_cli/config.py read/load semantics and tools/terminal_tool* (see guard evidence notes).
configAdmissionGuard.readHermesConfig: Returns HermesConfigReadResult: {status:'absent'} ONLY for a genuinely missing config.yaml under a valid (existing directory) config root (native built-in defaults apply); {status:'ok', config} for a parseable mapping (config.ok === true, no blocking shapes); {status:'error', problem} for unreadable / not-a-file (config path is a directory, FIFO/socket/device, or EISDIR/ENOTDIR layout; a non-regular file is classified WITHOUT attempting a read — a FIFO would block) / invalid-root / malformed-yaml / top-level-not-mapping / terminal-not-mapping / terminal-backend-type. A read failure is NEVER reported as null/absent/default-local.
configAdmissionGuard.parseHermesConfig: Returns a single ParsedHermesConfig object: ok:true with typed fields for a parseable mapping (or empty root -> defaults), or ok:false with a bounded `problem` for malformed YAML and invalid top-level/terminal/backend shapes. Malformed/invalid results are NEVER a usable config, and assertLocalTerminalBackend refuses them, so a failed parse passed straight into the check can never assert local. Backend string scalars are kept VERBATIM (never trimmed): native Hermes bridges the raw value to TERMINAL_ENV, so `" local "`, `"   "` and block-scalar values (`"local\n"`) survive into the typed view where the exact-value check classifies them — padding is never folded into "local". Only an exact empty string behaves as unset/empty (default-local). Parser messages (which embed raw source lines) are never copied; only bounded line/column numbers are returned.
configAdmissionGuard.assertLocalTerminalBackend: {ok:true} only for null (absent), an unset/exact-empty backend, or an explicit backend whose EXACT parsed string is 'local'. A parse result with ok:false is refused with its problem code. Known remote built-ins (docker/ssh/modal/singularity/daytona/vercel_sandbox, exact tokens) -> {ok:false, code:'terminal-backend-remote'}; any other explicit string — including whitespace-padded, whitespace-only and block-scalar variants — -> {ok:false, code:'terminal-backend-unknown'} (value never echoed; only the exact known remote token is echoed in the remote reason). Never {ok:true} for malformed/unreadable config — those are classified by the read/parse result and surfaced as ok:false at plan level.
configAdmissionGuard.facadeGating: resolveHermesAdapterPlan leaves launch null when prompt is absent OR admission is refused (profile.refused, config read error, non-local backend). launchAdmission {ok, code, reason} summarizes the primary refusal (profile-refused | one of the HermesConfigProblemCode values). plan.config is a structured HermesConfigReadResult; absence and failure are never conflated.
configAdmissionGuard.diagnostics: Reasons/details/plans contain bounded codes, field names, errno tokens and numeric locations only. Raw config lines, YAML-parser messages, credentials, dotenv values and arbitrary configured values are never copied into diagnostics. Synthetic-secret regressions assert no leakage.
configAdmissionGuard.optionsChange: ResolveHermesAdapterOptions.guestConfigRoot was REMOVED (previously silently ignored). Guest config-root mapping stays fixed at DEFAULT_GUEST_HERMES_ROOT / profiles/<name> per design section 6.3; a per-run guest-root override is a controller/operator integration decision for later shared integration.
configAdmissionGuard.hermesProfileChange: hermes-profile.ts only dropped two dead imports (readHermesConfig, ParsedHermesConfig type); profile resolution/refusal semantics are unchanged.

integrationGatesNotClosed: Live SQLite/WAL/VMFS cross-VM locking requires real VM proof; synthetic local tests do not prove it.
External profile/auth/skills dependency mounts (siblings, root stores) are controller/operator decisions; this adapter reports, it does not auto-mount.
vaivm-native model validation (deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp / deepseek, no Codex/MoA) is controller/operator-owned; this adapter reads config read-only.
Guest binary resolution and /workspace/runtime helper-pack mapping are controller-owned.
realpath containment for symlinked profile/store paths is a VFS integration gate; this delivery uses lexical containment.
